target.statement: Selective Type I error of the proposed ppolar test at α=0.05 after k-means on null Gaussian data (median over cells, e.g. isotropic covariance), i.e. a single cell of the Type I error table
target.dataset: Synthetic Gaussian data from the paper's simulation design (n up to 200, p up to 100, isotropic/AR(1)/compound-symmetric/spiked covariance)

compute.basis: Synthetic data plus an R package; one p-value takes 2-6 s on one core (M=5000, L=2), so a few hundred replicates for one (n,p,Σ) cell is minutes of compute, plus install and code-reading overhead.

blockers: Results are Monte Carlo estimates; exact table cell requires matching the paper's simulation seed/design
R package and reproduction repo must be installed and understood (no GPU, but some setup time)
title: Selective Inference for Clustering Under Unknown Covariance
